reduction: the two formulas (the database's formula 1, stated for 0.20–5.0 µm) evaluated at each wavelength of 380–780 nm every 5 nm and averaged in the dielectric function for randomly oriented grains, n² = (2n_o² + n_e²) ÷ 3, to six significant figures; k = 0, stated, since the sources give n only. The crystal is taken, as the plan's transparent high-index class does; amorphous Al2O3 (Begemann et al. 1997, Astrophys.
